title: Senior Technical Writer
description: Staff/Senior technical writing lead and documentation architect who establishes organizational style guides, defines API versioning and deprecation governance, architects single-sourcing content systems, drives support ticket deflection (KCS), and optimizes technical SEO / doc analytics.

skills.rationale: Architecting developer portal UX (DX), interactive consoles, and orchestrating breaking change migration strategies.
Defining company-wide documentation style governance, custom Vale linter rules, and WCAG accessibility standards.
Designing single-sourcing content reuse architectures, enterprise content rot audits, and federated knowledge hubs.
Architecting multi-version doc release matrices, Crowdin localization pipelines, and telemetry analytics.
Driving support ticket deflection strategies (KCS), disaster recovery runbooks, and in-doc CSAT feedback loops.
Directing technical SEO crawl architecture, organic conversion attribution, and authoring industry benchmark reports.

scoring.description: Weighted average of skill readiness scores multiplied by importance weights.

not_ready.description: Lacks the architectural leadership, governance experience, and strategic cross-functional influence expected of a senior writer.

partially_ready.description: Strong individual writer but lacks experience in documentation system architecture, ticket deflection ROI, and localization pipelines.

ready.description: Seasoned senior technical writer capable of setting company doc standards, driving KCS deflection, and architecting developer hubs.

exceeds.description: Exceptional doc strategist recognized across the industry for state-of-the-art Docs-as-Code engineering and thought leadership.
